photos.name: finished-rugelach
photos.summary: Sixteen finished crescents on a clear glass platter, arranged in loose rows. Pale gold — barely browned, confirming the recipe's reluctance to color even with +13 min over recipe time. Sugar topping glistens on tops. Currants escaped during shaping — scattered on the platter alongside the rolls. A few rolls show filling oozing from open ends; otherwise shapes are tighter and more uniform than last bake. Aesthetic: more disciplined rolling visible.
